title: Successful login with valid username and password
preconditions: A valid account exists (username: tomsmith, password: SuperSecretPassword!)
expected_result: User is redirected to https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/secure, a success flash message "You logged into a secure area!" is displayed, and the Logout button is visible.

title: Authenticated session persists on direct navigation to https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/secure
preconditions: User has successfully logged in (see TC-LOGIN-SUCCESS-001) and the session cookie is still valid
steps: While logged in, navigate away from https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/secure (e.g. to https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/login)
Navigate directly to https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/secure via the URL bar
expected_result: The https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/secure page loads directly without redirecting to https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/login; the user remains authenticated and the secure area content is shown.
